d:
The new Tesla Roadster is FINALLY HERE, and it can actually FLY?!
After almost NINE YEARS of waiting, Tesla has finally unveiled its next-generation Roadster, and it might just be the craziest electric supercar EVER!
With SpaceX-developed thrusters, a demonstrated 0-60mph time of under one second and a claimed top speed of over 230mph, Tesla is taking performance to a whole new level.
But that's not all... During its reveal, the Roadster was shown driving upside down, flipping through the air and even jumping over other cars!
